-- KY-4: Thomas Massie LOST primary to Ed Gallrein (Trump-endorsed Navy SEAL)
UPDATE house_races SET 
  candidate2_name = 'Ed Gallrein',
  candidate2_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'KY' AND district = '4';

-- KY-6: Open seat (Barr running for Senate) - R: Alvarado, D: Dembo
UPDATE house_races SET 
  candidate1_name = 'Zach Dembo',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Robert Alvarado',
  candidate2_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'KY' AND district = '6';

-- KY-2: D nominee is M. Wingfield (won plurality)
UPDATE house_races SET 
  candidate1_name = 'M. Wingfield',
  candidate1_party = 'D'
WHERE state_code = 'KY' AND district = '2';

-- KY-3: R nominee is M. Rodriguez (won plurality)
UPDATE house_races SET 
  candidate2_name = 'M. Rodriguez',
  candidate2_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'KY' AND district = '3';

SELECT state_code, district, status, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party 
FROM house_races WHERE state_code = 'KY' ORDER BY district;
